lines.text: The last season is upon us, and the Showdown is still wide open!

Here comes the final lap, and {leader} leads into it by {margin}!
The bell is about to ring for the last time, and {trailer} has not given up on a thing.
It all comes down to this, {leader}, and nobody is sitting back!
The last page of the story is still blank, and {leader} holds the pen for now.
{winnerClub} and {loserClub} walk toward the finale, and the tunnel has never felt so long.
A gap of {margin}, a season to play, and everything still to fight for!
The last chapter begins, and {trailer} has nothing to lose and a Showdown to win.
Through the door and into the finale, and only {leader} or {trailer} walks out a champion!
{leader} stands closest to the prize, but closest is not the same as there.
Hold your breath, {trailer}, because the deciding season is about to begin!
Nothing is won, nothing is lost, and the last season waits like an open door.

Last season, last chance, and a whole Showdown balanced on its edge!
They have come so far, {winnerClub} and {loserClub}, and now the very last stretch decides it all.

A lead of {margin} to defend, a Showdown to win, and a season to get through.

Rivals through all these seasons, {leader}, and now a last one to settle every argument.

{leader} has the edge, {trailer} has the nerve, and the last season has the final say!
Season {season} of {seasons}, the last of them, and the Showdown is still undecided!

All the trophies, all the points, all the late nights, and it comes down to this last season.
{trailer} must find something special, {leader} must hold the line, and the season awaits!
The console glows once more, and for {leader} the Showdown hangs on what happens next.
Neither {winnerClub} nor {loserClub} can afford to blink, because the finale is coming.
Of all the seasons in this Showdown, {trailer}, this is the one that closes the book!
Everything these two have built stands on the next season, and the whole room feels it.
What a place to finish, with {leader} in front by {margin} and {trailer} in no mood to wave goodbye!
Here is the last climb of the Showdown, and the summit is still anybody's, {leader}.
No more time to wait, no more seasons to spare, and {trailer} knows it better than anyone.
The curtain is rising on the closing season, and {winnerClub} takes a bow with {loserClub}.
The deciding season is here, and {leader} will need everything to stay in front!
Gloves off, {trailer}. This is the season that settles it, with no second chances.
We are at the last bend, and {leader} and {trailer} are leaning into it!
A last season, a last shot, and the air is thick with it!
Quiet before the storm, as {winnerClub} and {loserClub} prepare for the deciding season.
{leader} wants to finish the job, {trailer} wants to reopen it, and the stage is perfectly set.
All roads lead here, to the closing season of the Showdown, and nobody knows where it ends!
Final act, and {trailer} believes there is still a twist left in the story.
The margin is {margin}, the season is the last, and the cabinets are watching!
Long seasons, big moments, and now the closing season, with everything on the line!
You could not ask for a better setting: the Showdown open, the finale ahead, and two rivals ready.
{leader} carries the weight of the lead, and {trailer} carries the weight of the chase.
This season decides who gets the open-top bus and who gets the long walk home!
The last whistle of the Showdown is coming, {leader}, and the build-up has never been sweeter!
Do not blink, do not breathe, because the deciding season is about to kick off!
Two managers, a closing season, and a trophy cabinet with room for only a single story.
The ribbons are in the air, the Showdown is undecided, and {winnerClub} can smell the finale.
Everything could change in this season, and {trailer} knows exactly how little it takes.
There is a lead for {leader}, a hunger in {trailer}, and a finale to sort it all out!
Not a sound at the table, and the finale is still to come!
For {winnerClub} and {loserClub}, the deciding season brings a very particular kind of pressure.
The Showdown takes its final breath, {trailer}, and it is not a calm one!
It is not over until the last season says so, and {trailer} has been saying so for a while now.
Why do they play it all, {leader} and {trailer}? For a decider like this!
The road runs out after this season, and the winner is still waiting to be named.
Take your seats, {winnerClub} and {loserClub}, the closing season of the Showdown is about to begin!
Whatever happens, this season will be talked about long after the consoles are switched off.
{leader} looks at the finish line, {trailer} looks at {leader}, and the finale waits.
You wanted a decider, and you have got a decider!
A narrow ridge, a long drop, and the closing season of the Showdown standing right on top of it!

{margin} in front means plenty and means nothing with a season left, {leader}.

Hearts are thumping at {winnerClub} and {loserClub}, and the finale has not even started!

Tension all around, and {winnerClub} and {loserClub} have never needed a season so badly!

No excuses, no second thoughts, {trailer}, and a Showdown on the line!
Here it is, the biggest season of the Showdown, with the whole rivalry on its shoulders.
You can almost hear the console fan humming from here, because the deciding season is next!
{trailer} might be behind, but nobody is writing the ending yet.
The ending is close enough to touch, {leader}, and it still has not decided who it belongs to.

Already {leader} is thinking about the trophy cabinet. Careful, {leader}.
A crack of light under the door, and behind it the last season of the Showdown.
The final season dawns on {winnerClub} and {loserClub}, and both look ready.

A last season to prove who is best, and the rivalry has been waiting for it all along.
Everything that happened before has been pointing at this final season.
Sharpen the boots, {leader}, because {trailer} is coming for the lead!
Home straight, last bend, and {trailer} is still within reach of the Showdown!
The champion will be named after this season, and not a second sooner.
Sit tight, because the biggest chapter in the story is about to begin.
It is down to the wire, and the wire is only a season away!
A season that decides everything, for a rivalry that has given us plenty.
{leader} heads into the finale on top, and {trailer} follows with a very quiet smile.
The curtain falls after this season, and the Showdown has saved something special for it!
Steady hands, {leader}. {trailer} is hunting, and the finale is just ahead.
{winnerClub} on one side, {loserClub} on the other, and the Showdown on the line.
If {trailer} is going to do it, it has to be now, and everyone feels it!
Look at {leader}, looking at the finale, and none of it looks easy.

The whole room is quiet, {leader}, and the finale has not even kicked off!
A season to go, {trailer}, and a Showdown that has not made up its mind!
